_caveat: Derived from CLDR likelySubtags.xml (population-weighted defaults), not an exhaustive list of every language a script has ever been used for. Treat as "very likely safe," not proven unambiguous. Hand-edit if you find a gap. ISO 639-1 ONLY: languages with no 2-letter code (639-3-only) are dropped entirely from this table, and a script counts as "deterministic" here if it has exactly one 639-1 candidate — it may still have other 639-3-only languages using it in reality.
